name: v266_fx_cash_translation_tailwind
hypothesis: Positive and stable FX translation effects on cash can mark global-currency tailwinds that are distinct from ordinary foreign/domestic profit, debt, EPS, or cash-flow estimate routes.
field_notes: exchange_rate_effect_cash_equivalents has platform alphaCount=1 and local ACTIVE usage=0; exchange_rate_effect_on_cash has no local ACTIVE usage. Assets is used only as a scale denominator.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.550 * group_rank(ts_rank(exchange_rate_effect_on_cash / assets, 126), industry) + 0.250 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(exchange_rate_effect_cash_equivalents / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.200 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_std_dev(exchange_rate_effect_on_cash / assets, 126), 126), industry), -1)

name: v266_news18_impact_sentiment_neglect
hypothesis: High projected news impact with positive event sentiment and low event-record crowding may capture under-distributed important news rather than the already crowded earnings/product/legal news chains.
field_notes: news_impact_projection_score, event_sentiment_score, composite_sentiment_score_2, and story_event_record_count have local ACTIVE usage=0 as direct VECTOR fields.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.340 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(news_impact_projection_score), 90), industry) + 0.280 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(event_sentiment_score), 90), industry) + 0.200 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(story_event_record_count), 90), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(composite_sentiment_score_2) - vec_avg(event_sentiment_score)), 90), industry), -1)

name: v266_news18_editorial_equity_contrarian
hypothesis: Broad editorial and equity-market sentiment can be more useful as a contrarian pressure signal when paired with high projected impact and low story crowding, rather than as another ordinary positive-news sleeve.
field_notes: editorial_commentary_sentiment_2 and equity_sentiment_score are unused direct VECTOR fields locally and avoid earnings/dividend/legal/product labels.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.360 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(editorial_commentary_sentiment_2), 126), industry) + 0.280 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(equity_sentiment_score), 126), industry) + 0.200 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(news_impact_projection_score), 90), industry) + 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(story_event_record_count), 90), industry), -1)

name: v266_news18_reporting_freshness_impact
hypothesis: Impactful events tied to shorter, cleaner reporting windows and shorter event duration should be more actionable than stale or complex reporting-period stories.
field_notes: reporting_period_start/end time direct fields and event_start_time_utc_fast_d1 have local ACTIVE usage=0; this tests event timing rather than semantic news labels.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.340 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(reporting_period_end_time_utc_fast_d1) - vec_avg(reporting_period_start_time_utc_fast_d1)), 126), industry) + 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(event_end_time_utc) - vec_avg(event_start_time_utc_fast_d1)), 126), industry) + 0.240 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(news_impact_projection_score), 90), industry) + 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(event_sentiment_score), 90), industry), -1)

name: v266_news12_updown_reaction_asymmetry
hypothesis: After-news upside that reaches a 2% move faster than downside, without an extreme immediate five-minute jump, can indicate resilient liquidity and delayed positive digestion.
field_notes: minutes_to_2pct_decline and minutes_to_2pct_increase have platform alphaCount=0; this is the high-risk exploratory leg because news12 path fields have often been weak or LSUS-prone.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.380 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(minutes_to_2pct_decline) - vec_avg(minutes_to_2pct_increase), 60), industry) + 0.240 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(minimum_minutes_to_two_percent_move), 60), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(five_minute_price_change_pct_3)), 60), industry) + 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(story_event_record_count), 60), industry), -1)
